assets.description: Array of asset objects to create. Maximum 50 assets per request.

user_id.description: ID of the user performing the operation. Must have the DEVELOP_ASSETS permission.

assets[].file_id.description: ID of the file in Content Center. Must be a valid, supported file type.

assets[].hubs.description: List of valid hub IDs to add the asset to.

assets[].properties.name.description: Display name of the asset. Maximum 250 characters. Cannot contain / or \.

assets[].properties.description.description: Asset description. Maximum 1,000 characters, excluding HTML tags.

assets[].properties.asset_owner.description: Email of the asset owner. The user must have the necessary permissions.

assets[].properties.allow_download.description: Whether users can download the asset. Default: true.

assets[].properties.allow_mix_and_match.description: Whether the asset can be mixed with others. Default: false.

assets[].properties.allow_edit_content.description: Whether users can edit content. Default: false.

assets[].properties.allow_save_to_drive.description: Whether users can save to external drives. Default: false.

assets[].properties.expiry_date.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a future date.
